g.text: GALINI / L03 / SEC05 / Middle bridge and Taverna gateway
Named encounter section / adjacent architecture, explicit positions and a bounded review question
The span reaches a roofed receiving room. O03 blocks the
bridge-facing stance from the two district exits; moving
south of the tip opens the Fountain challenge, then the
north School door. The crossing remains an exposed
F0 cannot trade the next corner. F1 advances off the span
to support the leader around the shallow return. The
selected turn costs support and another clear; it does not
grant a protected holding room against an organized push.
Affected: BR-M, I04, M13, I09, O03, D13, D14, D15. Walk
routes: R07, R08, R10. All circles are body centers, not
L03 / geometry prediction. Later capture each listed stance from both sides, include the follower, and inspect standing/crouched exposure plus all intermediate stair or ramp
positions. Roofs and slabs remain opaque. Movement openings and observation apertures are different contracts.
